sentences.japanese: 会社の行く末は彼の肩に掛かっていた。
sentences.english: He bore the future of the company on his shoulders.

sentences.japanese: よいバッターになるためには、肩の力を抜いて、自分の直感に従ってやったらいい。
sentences.english: To be a good batter, you've got to hang loose and follow your instincts.

sentences.japanese: ビルは私の肩をぽんとたたいた。
sentences.english: Bill tapped me on the shoulder.

sentences.japanese: ちょっと手を休めて気持ちを和らげれば、肩のストレスや緊張感がとれるよ。
sentences.english: If you stop and relax, this will relieve the tension and stress in your shoulders.

sentences.japanese: チームが優勝して私も肩の荷が下りた。
sentences.english: It took a load off my mind when our team won the championship.
